summary: Recoil Rampart is a 90-second tower defense where a slow snail, mollusk, and gastropod parade marches across three lanes to chew your hand-drawn castle to rubble, while explosive mushrooms, slime trails, muzzle-flash smoke rings, shell-chip bursts, screen shake, and squash-and-boing ram kills keep every hit readable. Move the gold flag with Arrows/WASD and press Enter to plant cannons, press Space to fire them all, and then steer their recoil skid with the arrows to change lanes and ram snails flat before they eat the castle.
